May 17, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia
Scott Wallace increased its stake in Graham Hldgs Co (GHC) by 6.22% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wallace Capital Management Inc bought 6,012 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.83% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Scott Wallace held 102,594 shares of the other consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $57.28M, up from 96,582 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wallace Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Graham Hldgs Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $3.26 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.82% or $4.95 during the last trading session, reaching $607.55. About 5,623 shares traded. Graham Holdings Company (NYSE:GHC) has risen 1.87% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 9.68% the S&P500.
Texas Permanent School Fund decreased its stake in Service Corp Intl (SCI) by 7.29% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Texas Permanent School Fund sold 9,963 shares as the company’s stock rose 0.24% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 126,724 shares of the other consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.73M, down from 136,687 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Texas Permanent School Fund who had been investing in Service Corp Intl for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $6.90B market cap company.
